scoring_justification: The factor f is deterministically computed from public parameters via Eq.7; the checker recomputes it and compares with a small absolute tolerance.

schema.description: Three lines: first line is the relative contribution factor f; second line is the effective surface energy reduction Δα in N/m; third line is the Hooke's law deviation in percent. Each line is a single floating-point number.

outputs.description: Numerical values of the headline quantities: f from Eq. 7, Δα from Eq. 8, and Hooke's law deviation from Section 6.3.

output_contract.notes: The file contains three lines each with a single float representing the computed f, Δα, and Hooke's law deviation respectively.

steps.description: Recompute f from agent's output and compare to reference value derived from the same public parameters.
